name: $PluginName$
description: 演示用插件：把绑定里保存的配置变成响应头和延时，用来验证插件市场安装、启用与配置编辑的完整链路。

schemas.configJsonSchema: {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","title":"Demo Playground 配置","type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"required":["enabled"],"properties":{"enabled":{"type":"boolean","default":true,"title":"启用","description":"关掉后这条绑定不再产生任何效果，配置仍保留。"},"mode":{"type":"string","enum":["stamp","echo","silent"],"default":"stamp","title":"工作模式","description":"stamp 只往响应上加头；echo 直接返回当前配置（不转发上游）；silent 完全不介入。"},"badge":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"default":"demo","title":"标记","description":"写进 X-Demo-Badge 的标记，用来确认命中的是哪条绑定。"},"samplePercent":{"anyOf":[{"const":0},{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":100}],"default":0,"title":"生效比例（0-100）","description":"0 表示每个请求都生效；1-100 表示只对这一比例的请求生效。"},"delayMs":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":3000,"default":0,"title":"延时（毫秒）","description":"转发前人为增加的延时，用来观察超时与重试。"},"skipPaths":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"title":"跳过路径前缀","description":"请求路径以这些前缀开头时跳过，逗号分隔。"},"responseHeaders":{"type":"array","title":"附加响应头","description":"逐条添加，可增删多行。","items":{"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"required":["name","value"],"properties":{"name":{"type":"string","maxLength":64,"title":"名称"},"value":{"type":"string","maxLength":256,"title":"值"}}}},"echo":{"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"title":"echo 模式选项","description":"仅在 mode 为 echo 时使用。","properties":{"statusCode":{"type":"integer","minimum":200,"maximum":599,"default":200,"title":"状态码"},"pretty":{"type":"boolean","default":true,"title":"缩进输出"}}}}}
